name: Incorporation by reference
rule: Phase 99 incorporates all verified Phase 01-32 governed requirements/tests by reference and preserves original IDs.

name: Detailed source wins
rule: A derived summary cannot override the detailed governing source artifact.

name: No silent conflict resolution
rule: Apparent source conflicts require controlled change/ADR disposition.

name: Deterministic estimate authority
rule: Phase 26 remains authoritative for estimate calculation math.

name: Security everywhere
rule: Phase 28 security applies to all implementation/release layers.

name: AI cannot widen authority
rule: AI recommendations/tools cannot widen data access, approval authority or deterministic calculation authority.

name: Analytics not transaction authority
rule: Phase 29 analytical stores do not silently overwrite operational authorities.

name: Entitlement plus authorization
rule: Commercial entitlement and security authorization must both permit protected capability access.

name: Immutable release artifacts
rule: Production promotion uses the exact tested artifact and controlled configuration/migration references.

name: Evidence before acceptance
rule: Missing required evidence cannot be represented as PASS.

name: Exact-scope certification
rule: Certification applies only to the exact release/artifact/configuration/migration scope named.

name: Source ZIP immutability
rule: The incorporated phase ZIPs are not edited in place.

name: Stable IDs
rule: Existing governed IDs remain stable across master consolidation.

name: Versioned semantic change
rule: Changing governed meaning requires version/change evidence and impact analysis.

name: Provider binding via ADR
rule: Provider-neutral boundaries require approved ADR before binding.

name: Stop on blocking gate
rule: Implementation/promotion stops on unresolved blocking gates.

name: Real Phase 32 execution
rule: Production certification cannot be inferred from Phase 99 package completion.

name: Master manifest required
rule: Every Phase 99 release carries SHA-256 provenance/manifest.
